verdict.rationale: Annual-report preparation and filing is a fair question for a corporate compliance and registered-agent provider like CT Corporation, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes showing that every CT Corporation page sits behind a Cloudflare challenge. Nothing describes an annual-report filing service or add-on, so the verdict is none. Confidence is low because the gap reflects blocked access, not documented absence.

support.subject: As a founder, I can have the provider prepare and file my annual reports as a managed service or add-on
